# 7Sisters Farm

> AKC-registered Great Dane breeders in the Champaign-Urbana area of Central Illinois. Dustin and Karen Mayfield-Jones raise health-tested, family-raised Great Danes with a focus on sound structure and temperament. Motto: "Matching Great Danes with thoughtful people."

7Sisters Farm serves puppy families and breeder-community members across Illinois, Indiana, Iowa, Missouri, and Wisconsin. All puppies are the same flat price regardless of show/companion prospect or ear crop choice. Contact: dustin@mayfieldjones.com.

## Key pages

- [About Us](https://7sistersgreatdanes.com/about): Who Dustin and Karen are and how 7Sisters Farm started.
- [Our Great Danes](https://7sistersgreatdanes.com/7Sisters): The breeding dogs at 7Sisters Farm, their titles and health testing.
- [Breeding Philosophy](https://7sistersgreatdanes.com/BreedingPhilosophy): Our approach to responsible breeding, health testing, and breed betterment.
- [Puppies & Litters](https://7sistersgreatdanes.com/Litters): Current, upcoming, and past Great Dane litters.
- [Placement Process](https://7sistersgreatdanes.com/PlacementProcess): How we match puppies with families — inquiry, conversation, matching, lifetime support.
- [Common Questions](https://7sistersgreatdanes.com/CommonQuestions): FAQ on health testing, contracts, guarantees, and what to expect.
- [7Sisters Articles](https://7sistersgreatdanes.com/archive): Long-form guides on Great Dane breeding, care, development, and canine genetics.
- [Contact](https://7sistersgreatdanes.com/contact): Get in touch about available puppies or breeding questions.
